Sandbox_KIPN_HouseAllowClaimsInKIPNZones: Safehouse: Allow Claims Inside KIPN Zones

When enabled, players may establish new KIPN-managed safehouse claims whose building footprint overlaps an active KIPN Zone. When disabled, any new safehouse claim whose building overlaps an active KIPN Zone is rejected. Existing claims are not affected.
